findings.body:
Switching to `shell=True` with direct string interpolation of `upload_dir` and `name` enables command injection. Any value containing `;`, `|`, `` ` ``, `$(`, etc. will execute arbitrary shell commands.

```suggestion
    subprocess.run(
        ["convert", f"{upload_dir}/{name}", f"/srv/thumbs/{oid}.png"],
        check=True,
    )
```

summary: Critical command-injection risk introduced by switching to `shell=True` with unsanitized path components interpolated into the command string.

verification.reason: The patch replaces argv-list `subprocess.run` with `shell=True` and interpolates `upload_dir` and `name` into the command string, so metacharacters in those values execute as shell.
